Thanks Sanjay — good questions. Short answers up front: 

• DPA addendum with egress map and subprocessor roster: we can share a redlined addendum + graphic by Aug 10. That will include the current roster and a summary of our conditional failover paths (region affinity, 48h transient hop rules).

• Subprocessor on-call: we do maintain an ops contact list (teams + phone + escalation matrix). We typically provide the high-level on-call roster in the DPA addendum and a secure ops contact list in a follow-up Ops playbook (Doc link / restricted). If you want the full on-call phone roster in the DPA itself we can include a redacted directory—otherwise we link to the secure playbook and provide an SLA-backed escalation path. 

Can you confirm whether TheraHealth needs the phone-level contact info embedded in contract language or if an ops-playbook reference plus a contractual escalation SLA is sufficient? I want to tailor the deliverable to legal's needs.

I'll loop in Soojin from Security and Marissa from Legal Ops to validate timing and the egress diagram.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
